text: Wash the rice: put rice in a vessel, add water, mix and drain until water is clear.
Add rinsed rice to vessel with ~1 litre water and 1 tsp oil. Cover and cook/steam for 10-15 minutes until rice is cooked.
Remove cooked rice and keep aside.
Add 2 tsp oil to pan and heat.
Add chopped onion, 1 tsp jeera and 1 tsp salt; sautÃ© for 2-3 minutes.
Add curd (2 bowls) to the pan and mix well.
Add the steamed rice to the pan; mix thoroughly with a spoon.
Transfer curd rice to a big bowl and add chopped coriander leaves on top.
Spread batter on hot pan and cook both sides.
Pour batter into idli moulds and steam.
Layer vegetables and bake or simmer.
Blend mango and yogurt with sugar.
Cook rice and temper with curry leaves.
